name: Thwaites Glacier
description_en: The 'Doomsday Glacier' of West Antarctica. Its wide, deep bed slopes inland — a textbook case of Marine Ice Sheet Instability. Currently losing ~50 billion tonnes per year.
description_zh: '末日冰川'——西南极的思韦茨冰川。宽阔深邃的基岩向内陆倾斜——海洋冰盖不稳定性的教科书案例。目前每年损失约500亿吨冰。

key_facts_en: Known as the 'Doomsday Glacier' — its collapse could destabilize the entire West Antarctic Ice Sheet
The bed deepens inland, making it inherently unstable (MISI)
Currently retreating at ~800 m/year along the grounding line
key_facts_zh: 被称为'末日冰川'——其崩塌可能使整个西南极冰盖失稳
基岩向内陆加深，使其本质上不稳定（MISI）
目前接地线以每年约800米的速度退缩
